 Home Depot, Others Fight Bid To Merge Tariff Refund Suits
 By Jack McLoone · November 5, 2026, 5:20 PM EST 
 Home Depot said it opposed combining every proposed customer class action over increased costs from tariffs into multidistrict litigation, claiming there are too many economic differences between the suits. ...
